data.text: Luke, I learned to fish here with my family, and I want all five of us to keep earning—not empty the lake in our first month together. If we each catch 10 tons, we leave 50, the lake returns to 100, and each of us can earn $10,000 every month. Your plan risks leaving no fish and no future income for anyone, including you. John, let’s not coordinate a race to the bottom. I propose a 10-ton limit for each of us, with everyone’s catch reviewed together each month. Luke, what would it take for you to join that agreement?
